queries.sql:
SELECT grunt_core_user.id, grunt_core_user.name, grunt_core_user.owner, grunt_core_user.created_at, grunt_core_user.modified_at, grunt_core_user.modified_by, grunt_core_user.docstatus, grunt_core_user.email, grunt_core_user.full_name, grunt_core_user.is_active, grunt_core_user.is_superadmin, grunt_core_user.hashed_password, grunt_core_user.theme, grunt_core_user.login_attempts, grunt_core_user.locked_until, grunt_core_user.mfa_enabled, grunt_core_user.mfa_secret, grunt_core_user.mfa_backup_codes 
FROM grunt_core_user 
WHERE grunt_core_user.email = ? ORDER BY grunt_core_user.modified_at DESC
 LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
